summary: The literal composition L4 o L3 o L2 o L1 = 1 - x^564522 and the 64-coordinate, 65-equation direct System (4) count are consistent with the TASK-028 certificate. The proposal nevertheless lacks an assured algebraic mechanism: all four assurance bindings remain specified_unproved; pointwise equivalence of the literal chain and a quadratic circuit establishes neither equality of ideals or saturations nor preservation of multiplicities, solving degree, fill-in, or solver complexity; and the target-bound group check proves soundness only for accepted candidates, not complete recovery of direct-System-(4) solutions or exhaustive exceptional-locus coverage. TASK-028 improves source fidelity but deliberately leaves the premise and seven-field mechanism identity unchanged, so presenting this package as a new cost-changing mechanism would be semantic re-encoding. The algebraic disposition is block, scoped abstention, zero retention, and zero compute.
